) E LEFT JOIN ( SELECT EXECUTION_ID, ROW_COUNT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY EXECUTION_ID ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC, RESULT_ID DESC ) AS RESULT_RANK FROM QUERY_RESULT ) F ON F.EXECUTION_ID = E.EXECUTION_ID AND F.RESULT_RANK = 1 WHERE E.LATEST_RANK = 1 ORDER BY E.REQUESTED_AT DESC NULLS LAST, E.BATCH_ID DESC, E.EXECUTION_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT E.EXECUTION_ID, E.BATCH_ID, E.QUERY_ID, R.REQUEST_ID, R.REQUEST_NO, R.TITLE AS REQUEST_TITLE, I.QUERY_TITLE, I.SQL_TEXT, E.ATTEMPT_NO, E.STATUS, B.REQUESTED_AT, E.STARTED_AT, E.FINISHED_AT, E.DURATION_MS, E.ERROR_CODE, E.ERROR_MESSAGE, F.RESULT_ID, F.ROW_COUNT, F.FILE_SIZE, F.EXPIRES_AT, F.DELETED_AT FROM QUERY_EXECUTION E JOIN EXECUTION_BATCH B ON B.BATCH_ID = E.BATCH_ID JOIN QUERY_REQUEST R ON R.REQUEST_ID = B.REQUEST_ID JOIN QUERY_ITEM I ON I.QUERY_ID = E.QUERY_ID AND I.REQUEST_ID = R.REQUEST_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT RESULT_ID, EXECUTION_ID, ROW_COUNT, FILE_SIZE, EXPIRES_AT, DELETED_AT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY EXECUTION_ID ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC, RESULT_ID DESC ) AS RESULT_RANK FROM QUERY_RESULT ) F ON F.EXECUTION_ID = E.EXECUTION_ID AND F.RESULT_RANK = 1 WHERE E.EXECUTION_ID = #{executionId}
